item.title: Finance author-podcaster expands into wealth services under new RIA
item.description: Money News Network CEO Nicole Lapin and her RIA collaborators are building direct services through her growing base of readers, viewers and listeners.

item.title: The missing piece in most advisor succession plans
item.description: Many advisors haven't yet begun putting together an exit plan. Experts say there are common features and defined timelines that can help make it work.

item.title: To boost awareness of its retail bank, Morgan Stanley turns to E-Trade
item.description: The Wall Street giant still is often associated with deposits, lending and checking and savings accounts. But it's among the throng of firms seeking to give clients easy access to both banking and investing services online.

item.title: Behind the 'magic' of AI, advisors confront existential risk
item.description: Agentic AI will continue to automate financial planner workflows — and that's a good thing.

item.title: Ex-Citi exec alleges sexual harassment against Sieg in lawsuit
item.description: Rather than investigate her claims against the head of the firm's wealth unit, the accuser claims that Citi's human resources turned its spotlight on her. Citi denies the claims.

item.title: 1 in 3 retirees faces an RMD tax penalty. Here's how advisors help fix it
item.description: Missed IRA RMDs can cost clients thousands, Vanguard research shows. But financial advisors can help erase tax penalties and avoid future ones with a few key strategies.

item.title: How firms use equity stakes to retain top advisor talent, drive M&A
item.description: As valuations continue to rise across the industry, more firms are using compensation to invest in their top talent and future growth, Succession Resource Group says.

item.title: LPL's Linsco channel pulls $2B team from Fifth Third Private Bank
item.description: An wealth management duo from Ohio chooses LPL's unit for direct employee advisors to found Moto Wealth Partners.

item.title: Michael Kitces' new AdvisorEconomics brings benchmarking to firms
item.description: The new business intelligence service uses several key performance indicators to help advisors decide how to best manage their talent and resources.

item.title: Wells Fargo's FiNet pulls from Ameriprise, Raymond James, UBS
item.description: Two teams and one advisor managing a combined $1.3 billion choose to set up shop at Wells Fargo's channel for independent advisors.
